title: South Florida Friday and Saturday Night Picks
igCaption:
Friday and Saturday plans in Miami.
Nov. 6 and 7, Miami venues, prices vary

scenes.text: Friday and Saturday plans start with the clubs, then dinner can handle the rest.

scenes.text: For dinner before the night starts, LPM in Brickell unveiled a $3 million transformation. The restaurant added an expanded patio, a separate entrance, and a new 10-cocktail Déjà Vu menu.

scenes.text: Pastis opened in West Palm Beach this October at the Nora Hotel. It's the restaurant's fifth location, on the ground floor of a 201-room hotel.
